page.overview:
Who is Alauni?

Alauni was a Twi'lek female Senator who represented the planet Saleucami in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Cold War.

During the war, Alauni was among those who joined the Rift Alliance to protest what they perceived as the incompetence of the Galactic Republic.
